ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this is a verified rider no-show, so the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it.

Rider — your request to reverse the fee is not supported. The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 21:58:18, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02704) shows him stationary inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same second: one continuous in-geofence run of 454 seconds, from 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300-second free waiting period carried in this trip's platform policy (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300). He messaged you at 21:58:48 ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'); the chat log (EV-CHAT-02704) shows you read it at 21:59:38 and did not reply before he cancelled at 22:05:55, recorded as RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. Your own device track places you 606 to 613 m from the pickup pin, stationary, across the whole window, so the account that you were walking to the bay is not consistent with your own trace. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you: it needs a locating message sent by you in the log, and the log holds only the driver's message, so limb (a) fails. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold, so the fee is chargeable.

Driver — the fee stands and POL-NS-07 fixes your payout. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the first in-geofence fix is at the arrival timestamp itself (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), the trace shows a stationary fix rather than 15 km/h or more, and the point is not beyond 300 m, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and the 454-second dwell is comfortably over the 300-second requirement — POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall. Because your stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-03 (the wrong-entrance clause, 400 m) does not apply. Your compensation is 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee = SGD 3.20, confirmed by the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02704, derived money.driver_compensation 3.20), and the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d = 2, below the count of 4, and 2/111 completed trips in 30 days ≈ 0.018, below the rate of 0.08.

The traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02704-01) is MISSING at weight 0.0. Both advocates' claims about it were discarded by the referee for citing an impaired artifact without naming its issue code (MISSING_ARTIFACT), so they are not grounds in this ruling; in any event no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed, because the single continuous 454-second run already exceeds the 300-second minimum, and a missing advisory carries no deciding fact here.

Confidence is 0.92: the deciding facts — arrival, dwell, the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination and the SGD 4.00 charge — are carried by EV-GPS-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 and EV-FARE-02704, each at weight 1.0, and no artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) (no clock skew, no trace gap, the chat holds the one message the trip record counts, and the fare line of SGD 4.00 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00).

Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.20; the rider's charge is left as it stands (NO_ACTION as to your fee). No referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival is not triggered and no clause directs one. The monetary effect of SGD 3.20 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically under POL-GEN-05.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
